claim_text: 來源機構：Interactive Learning Environments（Taylor & Francis）；資料標題：Generative AI as an interactive learning environment in early childhood: preschool children's emerging AI literacy as socially distributed interpretive work in collaborative storytelling；來源刊登日：2026-11-10。作者摘要報告：研究以質性個案研究，探討土耳其東南部一所公立幼兒園的全班 AI 輔助說故事活動；資料為 17 份土耳其語逐字稿（涉及 22 名 5–6 歲幼兒）及影音與圖像紀錄；作者報告在所檢視的片段中，幼兒把 AI 當成圖像產生者，對非預期產出提出能動性的解釋，有時也把提示的特徵連結到產出結果。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

original_excerpt: This qualitative case study examined whole-class AI-assisted storytelling in a public preschool in southeastern Türkiye. … The corpus consists of 17 Turkish transcript files from the episodes (involving 22 children aged 5–6 years), along with available video and image records. … In the individual episodes that were examined, the children treated the AI as an image producer, offered agentive explanations for unexpected outputs, and on occasion, linked features of the prompt to the resulting outputs.

summary_evidence_spans: This qualitative case study examined whole-class AI-assisted storytelling in a public preschool in southeastern Türkiye.
The corpus consists of 17 Turkish transcript files from the episodes (involving 22 children aged 5–6 years), along with available video and image records.

In the individual episodes that were examined, the children treated the AI as an image producer, offered agentive explanations for unexpected outputs, and on occasion, linked features of the prompt to the resulting outputs.

source_title: Effectiveness of an AI-Based Adaptive Assessment System for Conceptual Mastery in Grade 8 Mathematics: Protocol for a Cluster-Randomised Trial with Simulation-Based Design Checks
title_zh: 以 AI 為基礎的適性評量系統對八年級數學概念精熟之成效：附模擬設計檢核的群集隨機試驗計畫書
source_locator: 出版者 PDF（管理者 2026-11-14 提供；MDPI 頁回 403）：Published: 12 November 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2、3、4 句與末句
original_excerpt: This protocol describes a two-arm cluster-randomised trial in schools that follow the Cambridge Lower Secondary Mathematics framework. … Grade 8 mathematics teachers will be randomised within schools to AIMAS-8, a system that combines a concept-level dynamic Bayesian learner model, prerequisite-aware item selection and expert-authored misconception feedback, or to the same items delivered in a fixed order with worked solutions. … Both arms receive twelve 30 min sessions on linear relationships. … No participant data have been collected.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的試驗設計、分派方式、兩組條件與課程次數，以及尚未蒐集資料的說明；結果指標、檢定力與模擬檢核內容不寫入，也不寫任何成效。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Education Sciences，監測清單 J47）；研究計畫書，尚未蒐集參與者資料；試驗設計為採 Cambridge 初中數學架構學校的八年級數學。

attributed_summary: 研究計畫書描述在採 Cambridge 初中數學架構學校進行的兩組群集隨機試驗：八年級數學教師將在校內隨機分派至 AI 適性評量系統 AIMAS-8，或改以固定順序呈現相同題目並附解答；兩組皆上 12 次、每次 30 分鐘的線性關係課程；作者說明尚未蒐集參與者資料。
summary_evidence_spans: This protocol describes a two-arm cluster-randomised trial in schools that follow the Cambridge Lower Secondary Mathematics framework.

Grade 8 mathematics teachers will be randomised within schools to AIMAS-8, a system that combines a concept-level dynamic Bayesian learner model, prerequisite-aware item selection and expert-authored misconception feedback, or to the same items delivered in a fixed order with worked solutions.
Both arms receive twelve 30 min sessions on linear relationships.
No participant data have been collected.
